[ASSISTANT_SAID] Advanced analytics techniques such as machine learning, artificial intelligence, and natural language processing are applied to data by law enforcement agencies.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Predictive policing forecasts where and when crimes are most likely to occur using historical crime data, geospatial data, and other relevant data sources.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Law enforcement agencies can deploy resources more effectively and efficiently by identifying hotspots, patterns, and trends through predictive policing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Agencies are investing in advanced data analytics tools and technologies and recruiting personnel with data analytics and data science expertise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Collaboration with other agencies and organizations is occurring to share data and expertise, enhancing capabilities.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Effective allocation of resources, such as patrols in high crime areas, can reduce response times and develop targeted interventions.
